description: This file defines a class 'MacPort' implementing the Port interface for Chromium on Mac OS, including supported versions, fallback paths, build instructions URL, and methods for determining port name, checking build, and locating system paths.

classes.name: MacPort
classes.description: A class representing the Mac-specific implementation of the Port interface for Chromium's layout tests.

methods.name: determine_full_port_name
methods.description: Determines the full port name based on host platform and options, appending version info.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes a MacPort instance, extracting version info from port_name.

methods.name: check_build
methods.description: Checks if the build environment meets requirements, logs instructions URL if not.

methods.name: path_to_apache
methods.description: Returns the system path to the Apache HTTP server.

methods.name: path_to_apache_config_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the Apache configuration file.

methods.name: _path_to_driver
methods.description: Returns the path to the driver application, optionally with a target.
